As we learn more, it has become clear that the mechanism is elegant but not as simple as first thought. It is also evident that, although many species use similar, sometimes identical, DNA sequences for telomeres, these species express their own individuality in the way they regulate these sequences and, perhaps, in the additional tasks that they have imposed on their telomeric DNA.
